description.value: The Reach is a community-rooted neighbourhood pub on Dewdney Trunk Road in Maple Ridge, serving no-fuss comfort food alongside a rotating selection of local craft beers. It functions as a genuine local gathering place with weekly themed food specials, live music nights, and Sunday trivia. Touring cyclists passing through Maple Ridge's Fraser Valley corridor would find a welcoming, unpretentious stop with a full pub menu and a strong sense of neighbourhood hospitality.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and recently updated (2026-04-28), confirming the business is open; phone (604 465 7715) and address (20398 Dewdney Trunk Rd, Maple Ridge, BC) are stated on the website and consistent with OSM. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via the reservations page ('ENJOY YOUR MEAL AT HOME TAKE OUT'), and at least one vegetarian menu item is evidenced by cauliflower as a listed taco filling; no mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears anywhere on the site, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number listed; 604-465-7715 sourced from website and used as the top-level phone value. contact_confirmed.phone set to null as there is no OSM value to corroborate.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A full-service neighbourhood pub with confirmed takeout, comfort food, and local craft beers along Dewdney Trunk Road — a practical and welcoming food-and-drink stop for touring cyclists moving through Maple Ridge.
